reviews.t: WNCC AME ZION 2021 Annual Conference was beautiful from the opening song to the Benediction! The setting was the icing on the cake!!! Black Mountain is beautiful and Camp Dorothy Walls is quickly becoming one of my favorite 'high places'... #MountainBeauty

I would give less than one star if I could. This organization is morally bankrupt. My family's home was destroyed by hurricane Helene. We were lucky enough to escape at the very last minute along with our dogs and after a terrifying ordeal and a long walk to a family member's home that involved a brief walk with our dogs along the sidewalk on the perimeter of the center, we were aggressively told to get off of private property. Other religious organizations are opening up their resources to a devastated community, but Camp Dorothy Walls is making sure that displaced members of the community don't get dirt on their sidewalk during a natural disaster. That should tell you everything you need to know
Incredible people! Thank you for serving and using your infrastructure to support recovery!
